Integrated STEM Lab Setup Service

We don't just equip a room, we build an environment that inspires young innovators. Here's how we transform your institution into the future in 4 steps:

Get Started
Our Process

4-Step Transformation

From assessment to empowerment - a complete journey to building your STEM lab

  1. 1

    Assessment & Needs Analysis (Consultation)

    Before placing any nail, we understand your institution's 'identity':

    • Age group identification: Customizing tools to fit (Early Childhood, Elementary, or Secondary)
    • Space analysis: Utilizing available space to provide areas (brainstorming, manufacturing, testing)
    • Educational objectives: Is the focus on Robotics, Programming, Sustainability, or Digital Manufacturing?
  2. 2

    Engineering Design & Educational Environment (Design Lab)

    We design a place that stimulates creativity, not just a traditional classroom:

    • Flexible furniture: Movable tables and organized shelves that serve teamwork
    • Technical distribution: Securing power points, internet, and smart display means
    • Visual identity: Inspiring decorations that reflect the spirit of engineering and innovation
  3. 3

    Equipment & Technical Solutions (Hard & Soft Solutions)

    We provide the latest global technologies carefully selected:

    • Digital Manufacturing: 3D Printers and Laser Cutting Machines
    • Robotics & Artificial Intelligence: Customized educational kits
    • Related logistics: High-spec computers or tablets equipped with simulation software
  4. 4

    Empowerment & Support (Training & Support)

    A lab doesn't work without qualified staff, so we commit to:

    • Teacher training: Intensive workshops on how to integrate STEM tools into curricula
    • Educational content: Providing ready-to-implement training packages and practical projects
    • Maintenance & technical support: Ensuring continuity of work and periodic software updates
